description: Canonical use case registry per Directive §11. Consolidated from siteContent.ts (outcomeCategories, trustEvidence, useCaseStudies) and useCaseCatalogData.ts (CATALOG_USE_CASES, PLATFORM_SCENARIOS, CATALOG_INDUSTRIES).

useCases.title: J&S StopOver Bar — Live SME Use Case
useCases.problem: Malawian SME needs real-time inventory, sales, cash reconciliation, procurement, and profitability monitoring without a full team.
useCases.workflow: Agentic decision support monitors inventory levels, sales velocity, cash reconciliation, procurement needs, and profitability — demonstrating AI-native operations in the informal economy.
useCases.orchestration: MessageBus task queue with 5-tier approval for procurement triggers; executor loop with recall-before-execute memory integration.
useCases.humanApproval: Tier 2 (Department Lead) for procurement triggers; Tier 1 (Auto) for monitoring and alerts
useCases.output: Real-time dashboard with inventory alerts, sales trends, cash position, procurement recommendations, and profitability tracking
useCases.businessValue: Tangible proof that AI Company Builder works outside a lab on a real business in a Malawian market — functional coverage of a multi-person team for a solo operator.

useCases.title: LightSpeed Holdings Limited — The Meta Use Case
useCases.problem: Need to prove the AI Company Builder platform works by using it to run the company that builds it.
useCases.workflow: CEO directs strategy; 90 AI agents (89 AI + 1 Human CEO) handle operations across 20 departments — orchestration, memory, tools, governance, and value measurement all running on the platform being offered.
agentsInvolved: All 90 agents across Executive, Technology, Operations, AI Research, Finance, Marketing, Sales, People, Security, Legal, Strategy, Customer Success, Product, Data, IT
useCases.orchestration: Full H-A-O-M-T-G-V stack: Human CEO → 90 Agents → Orchestration (MessageBus) → Memory (6-type store) → Tools (multi-provider LLM, local infra) → Governance (5-tier approval, audit trails) → Value (measured KPIs)
tools: Full tool vocabulary (read, write, execute, grep, list, webfetch, delegate)
useCases.humanApproval: 5-tier matrix: Tier 1 (Auto) → Tier 2 (Lead) → Tier 3 (Exec) → Tier 4 (CEO) → Tier 5 (Board); expiry sweep on pending approvals
useCases.output: Operating company delivering: public website, AI Company Builder platform, Pharos insights, client engagements, internal operations
useCases.businessValue: Not a prototype or slide deck — an operating company that builds and relies on the exact software it licenses. Proves 5-tier HITL approvals, immutable audit trails, RACI matrices, and governance controls operate daily in production.

useCases.title: Malawi Central Bank Compliance Automation
useCases.problem: Regional financial institution needs regulatory reporting across 14 departments with full audit trails — currently manual and time-intensive.
useCases.workflow: Governed multi-agent compliance framework automates regulatory report generation, data collection from 14 departments, validation, and audit trail sealing — reducing reporting time by 40%.
useCases.orchestration: Multi-agent workflow with 5-tier approval gates; each department's data passes validation before aggregation; SHA-256 sealed audit trail for every action
useCases.humanApproval: Tier 3 (Executive) for final report sign-off; Tier 2 (Department Lead) for data validation; Tier 1 (Auto) for data collection
useCases.output: Automated regulatory reports across 14 departments with immutable audit trails; 40% reduction in compliance reporting time
useCases.businessValue: Regulatory compliance delivered at speed with full accountability; audit-ready evidence for every data point

useCases.title: SADC Agricultural Cooperative Digital Platform
useCases.problem: Agricultural cooperatives across Malawi and Mozambique need coordination, mobile-money payments, and supply chain tracking — operating in low-bandwidth, Chichewa-speaking environments.
useCases.workflow: WhatsApp-native coordination platform with mobile-money integration (Airtel Money, TNM Mpamba), supply chain tracking, and Chichewa-language advisory — serving 1,200 cooperative members in pilot.
useCases.orchestration: MessageBus routes WhatsApp messages to appropriate agents; local-first inference for Chichewa NLP; mobile money webhooks trigger reconciliation agents
useCases.humanApproval: Tier 2 (Cooperative Lead) for procurement decisions; Tier 1 (Auto) for advisory and tracking
useCases.output: Coordinated cooperative operations with mobile payments, supply visibility, and farmer advisory in local language
useCases.businessValue: First WhatsApp-native, mobile-money-integrated, Chichewa-capable platform for African agricultural cooperatives — serving 1,200 members in pilot

useCases.title: University of Malawi Student Management System
useCases.problem: University needs student management and credential verification with GDPR-level data protection and immutable audit trails across multiple departments.
useCases.workflow: Agent-driven student management system onboards 3 departments, processes 5,000 records with immutable audit trails, and provides credential verification — all under GDPR-level protection.
useCases.orchestration: Department-level agents coordinate with central records agent; every action logged to SHA-256 audit trail; data sovereignty maintained on local infrastructure
useCases.humanApproval: Tier 2 (Department Head) for record modifications; Tier 3 (Registrar) for credential issuance; Tier 1 (Auto) for queries
useCases.output: 3 departments onboarded, 5,000 records processed, credential verification with full audit trail and GDPR compliance
useCases.businessValue: Demonstrates sovereign, audit-ready student management for African universities — scalable to national education systems

useCases.title: Health / M&E Clinic Supply Chain Monitoring
useCases.problem: Clinics need supply chain monitoring with automated procurement on anomaly detection, and donor-ready M&E reports from Kobo/DHIS2 data.
useCases.workflow: Agentic workflows monitor clinic supply chains, detect Z-score anomalies, auto-generate procurement requests, and produce donor-ready reports from Kobo and DHIS2 data — accelerating data collection to boardroom reporting from weeks to hours.
useCases.orchestration: Scheduled monitoring agents feed anomaly detector; procurement requests auto-generated on threshold breach; report agents transform raw data to donor templates
useCases.humanApproval: Tier 2 (Clinic Manager) for procurement approval; Tier 1 (Auto) for monitoring and report generation
useCases.output: Real-time supply chain visibility, automated procurement on anomaly, donor-ready reports in hours not weeks
useCases.businessValue: Accelerates field data to boardroom decisions; critical for health systems in resource-constrained environments

useCases.title: VSLA / SACCO / Mobile Money Financial Inclusion
useCases.problem: Informal savings groups (VSLA/SACCO) and micro-finance institutions need automated savings tracking, mobile-money reconciliation, and credit scoring over Airtel Money/TNM Mpamba rails.
useCases.workflow: Agentic workflows integrate with Airtel Money and TNM Mpamba to track savings group transactions, reconcile mobile money records, and assess micro-loan risk for smallholder farmers.
useCases.orchestration: Mobile money webhooks trigger reconciliation; savings agents aggregate group data; credit scoring runs on aggregated financial behavior
useCases.humanApproval: Tier 3 (Institution Lead) for loan approvals; Tier 2 (Group Coordinator) for savings validation; Tier 1 (Auto) for reconciliation
useCases.output: Automated savings tracking, reconciled mobile money records, credit scores for smallholder farmers — targeting financial inclusion across COMESA/Africa
useCases.businessValue: Addresses financial inclusion gap for informal savings groups; enables micro-finance at scale with mobile-money rails

useCases.title: Chichewa AI / Ministry of Agriculture Piloting
useCases.problem: Need bilingual Chichewa & English natural language understanding for farmer advisory, citizen-query, and public-service agents — ensuring AI accessibility for non-English speaking rural populations.
useCases.workflow: Building Chichewa-language foundation via piloting with Ministry of Agriculture: bilingual NLP, contextual agricultural reasoning, and farmer advisory agents in Malawi's most spoken language.
useCases.orchestration: Local Ollama models for Chichewa inference; agricultural reasoning agents apply domain knowledge; advisory agents generate contextual responses
useCases.humanApproval: Tier 2 (Agriculture Extension Officer) for advisory validation; Tier 1 (Auto) for routine queries
useCases.output: Bilingual Chichewa/English farmer advisory with contextual agricultural reasoning — accessible to rural smallholder farmers
useCases.businessValue: Ensures AI capability is accessible to non-English speaking rural populations; foundation for all public-service agents in Malawi

useCases.title: Startup Acceleration — Solo Founder + Governed AI Workforce
useCases.problem: Solo founder needs functional coverage of a multi-person team (CTO, CFO, CMO, CLO) without hiring overhead.
useCases.workflow: Founder sets vision; 90 AI agents execute operations across 20 departments with CEO dashboard for real-time visibility — founder directs, agents deliver.
useCases.orchestration: Full AI Company Builder stack: Human CEO (founder) → 90 Agents → Orchestration → Memory → Tools → Governance → Value
useCases.humanApproval: Founder at Tier 4/5 for strategic decisions; agents operate at Tier 1-3 for execution
useCases.output: Functional multi-department operation from solo founder — LightSpeed itself operates this way
useCases.businessValue: Enables solo founders to operate with enterprise-grade capability; proven by LightSpeed's own operation

useCases.title: Enterprise Automation — Augment Existing Teams
useCases.problem: Enterprise teams need specialist AI agents for compliance scanning, data pipelines, and contract review without 6-month hiring cycles.
useCases.workflow: Existing teams gain specialist agents that adapt to organizational structure via YAML configuration — compliance, data, and legal agents deploy in days not months.
useCases.orchestration: Agents integrate via MessageBus with existing workflows; YAML config defines department mapping and approval thresholds
useCases.humanApproval: Tier 2-3 per enterprise governance model; integrates with existing approval chains
useCases.output: Specialist AI capacity deployed in days; compliance and operational bottlenecks automated
useCases.businessValue: 6-month hiring cycle compressed to days; governance preserved; African enterprise teams can automate immediately

useCases.title: Consulting Firm Scale — Delivery Backbone for Professional Services
useCases.problem: Consulting firms sell expertise but are constrained by headcount — research, analysis, and report generation consume billable hours.
useCases.workflow: Agents handle research, analysis, and report generation; humans focus on client relationships and strategic advisory — delivery backbone scales with demand.
useCases.orchestration: Project-based agent teams spin up per engagement; human partners review at key gates; immutable audit trails for client deliverables
useCases.humanApproval: Tier 3 (Partner) for final deliverables; Tier 2 (Manager) for work product review; Tier 1 (Auto) for research/analysis
useCases.output: Scaled delivery capacity without linear headcount growth; consultants focus on high-value advisory
useCases.businessValue: Advisory, legal, and financial consulting firms across Africa can scale delivery without hiring bottlenecks

useCases.title: Non-Profit Operations — Full Capability with Minimal Staff
useCases.problem: Small non-profits need coverage across finance, HR, compliance, M&E, and donor communications but cannot afford full teams.
useCases.workflow: Agent teams cover finance, HR, compliance, M&E, and donor comms; immutable audit trails provide exact documentation grantmakers require; local Ollama models enable zero-API-cost deployment.
useCases.orchestration: Department agents coordinate via MessageBus; local-first operation on minimal infrastructure; audit trails auto-generated for grant compliance
useCases.humanApproval: Tier 2 (Program Manager) for financial/grant actions; Tier 1 (Auto) for reporting and tracking
useCases.output: Full operational coverage for non-profit with 1-2 staff; grant-ready audit trails; zero API costs via local models
useCases.businessValue: Local NGOs, community cooperatives, and international grant recipients get enterprise capability at fraction of cost

useCases.title: Government Compliance — Authorisation-Aligned Public Sector AI
useCases.problem: State departments need AI agents for compliance monitoring, contract review, and regulatory reporting — aligned with government authorization levels and SADC frameworks.
useCases.workflow: Agents handle compliance monitoring, contract review, regulatory reporting; 5-tier approval matrix maps directly to government authorization levels and SADC digital transformation frameworks.
useCases.orchestration: Government-grade RBAC and approval mapping; agents operate within authorized boundaries; audit trails meet public sector standards
useCases.humanApproval: Tier 4-5 (Permanent Secretary/Minister) for policy actions; Tier 3 (Director) for compliance; Tier 2 (Manager) for operations
useCases.output: Authorisation-aligned AI for public sector; compliance and reporting automated within governance frameworks
useCases.businessValue: State departments, regulatory agencies, and municipal administrations get AI capability that respects authorization hierarchies

useCases.title: E-Commerce Customer Success — 24/7 WhatsApp Conversational Commerce
useCases.problem: Mobile-first retailers need customer success, sales pipeline, and marketing analytics without shift-based human teams.
useCases.workflow: WhatsApp-native agents maintain customer context across interactions, process mobile-money checkouts, escalate high-value issues, and provide 24/7 coverage.
useCases.orchestration: Conversation state maintained in memory; mobile money webhooks trigger fulfillment; escalation rules route to human for high-value
useCases.humanApproval: Tier 2 (Store Manager) for escalations and high-value decisions; Tier 1 (Auto) for routine support and checkout
useCases.output: 24/7 conversational commerce with mobile money, context-aware support, and sales analytics — no shift teams needed
useCases.businessValue: African mobile-first retailers & WhatsApp merchant networks get enterprise customer success at startup cost

useCases.title: Healthcare Administration — Clinical Administrative Relief & Memory Encryption
useCases.problem: Hospitals and clinics need billing compliance, patient scheduling, credentialing, and regulatory reporting — so clinical staff focus on patients.
useCases.workflow: Agents handle administrative burden (billing, scheduling, credentialing, reporting); memory encryption and PII detection for Malawi DPA & GDPR compliance.
useCases.orchestration: Zero-Cloud Boundary option for PII; memory encryption at rest; audit trails for every administrative action; local-first deployment
useCases.humanApproval: Tier 3 (Clinical Director) for patient-affecting decisions; Tier 2 (Admin Lead) for billing/scheduling; Tier 1 (Auto) for reporting
useCases.output: Administrative automation with clinical-grade data protection; staff redirected to patient care
useCases.businessValue: Hospitals, private clinics, and rural health networks reduce admin burden while maintaining DPA/GDPR compliance

useCases.title: Financial Services — Risk & Continuous Regulatory Compliance
useCases.problem: Microfinance institutions, SACCOs, and regional banks need continuous compliance monitoring, risk analysis, and audit preparation.
useCases.workflow: Agents provide continuous compliance monitoring, risk analysis, and audit preparation; 5-tier approval matrix maps to financial services authorization levels and central bank reporting rules.
useCases.orchestration: Continuous monitoring agents feed risk analyzer; compliance gaps trigger approval workflows; audit prep agents compile evidence packages
useCases.humanApproval: Tier 4 (CEO/Board) for risk limit changes; Tier 3 (Risk Officer) for compliance actions; Tier 2 (Compliance Officer) for monitoring
useCases.output: Continuous compliance posture, real-time risk visibility, audit-ready evidence packages — aligned with central bank rules
useCases.businessValue: Microfinance institutions, SACCOs, and regional banking providers get continuous compliance without manual overhead
